related_questions.question: Does COVID come on suddenly?
related_questions.snippet: COVID-19 symptoms may appear 2-14 days after exposure to the virus. The symptoms of a cold may come on gradually, while the flu usually starts abruptly. Below is a chart that may help determine which illness you have.
related_questions.title: IS IT A COLD, FLU OR COVID-19? - Sanford Health

text_blocks.snippet: To help COVID-19 go away, focus on supportive care like rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications to manage symptoms. For individuals at higher risk of severe illness, antiviral medications may be prescribed to help prevent the virus from multiplying. Consult a healthcare professional for personalized advice and treatment options.
snippet_highlighted_words: focus on supportive care like rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications to manage symptoms

list.title: Rest and Hydration:
list.snippet: Getting enough sleep and drinking plenty of fluids helps your body's natural defenses fight the virus.

list.title: Symptom Management:
list.snippet: Over-the-counter medications like fever reducers (acetaminophen or ibuprofen), pain relievers, and cough medicine can help alleviate symptoms.

list.title: Antiviral Medications:
list.snippet: If you are at higher risk of severe illness, your doctor may prescribe antiviral medications to help reduce the severity of the illness and prevent it from worsening, according to the CDC.

list.title: Consult a Healthcare Professional:
list.snippet: It's crucial to consult with a doctor to determine the best course of action for your specific situation, especially if you have underlying health conditions or are at higher risk of complications.

related_questions.question: What does a mild case of COVID feel like?

text_blocks.snippet: A mild case of COVID-19 often feels like a bad cold or the flu. Common symptoms include a runny nose, sore throat, headache, fatigue, and a cough. Some people also experience fever or chills, sneezing, and a hoarse voice. Loss of taste or smell, and nausea can also occur.
